title: TaskTakeInput
description: Input of `gentry task take --input`: the fields of the task as one object, in a file or on the standard input. An unknown field is an error. The source of the statement is not part of the input: Gentry determines it by who calls the command.

scenario.description: Identifier of the scenario of the task.

title.description: Title of the task: one line of up to 80 characters.

statement.description: Statement of the task, kept as passed.

worktree.description: Worktree of the task; the current directory by default.
